description: This file defines the PortGuardian actor responsible for managing, monitoring, and diagnosing network port listeners on macOS. It includes functionalities for recording port usage, killing processes holding specific ports, reading process commands, and generating reports on port status, with support for debugging and testing.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor that manages port monitoring, process recording, and port diagnostics for macOS applications.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Record
classes.description: A codable struct representing a record of a port being used by a process, including port number, PID, command, mode, and timestamp.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Descriptor
classes.description: A struct holding process descriptor information, such as PID, command, and optional executable path.

classes.name: PortGuardian.PortReport
classes.description: A struct representing a report about a port's status, including expected command, listeners, and status details.

classes.name: PortGuardian.ReportListener
classes.description: A struct representing a listener process on a port, including PID, command, user, and whether it's expected.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Scans and potentially terminates processes holding certain ports based on the mode, logging the actions.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records port usage details into persistent storage.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes port records associated with a specific PID.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for a port, including process details.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Produces diagnostic reports on port statuses.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the gateway via HTTP request.

methods.name: isListening
methods.description: Determines if a given port (and optional PID) is being listened on.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Retrieves current listeners on a specific port using lsof.

methods.name: readFullCommand
methods.description: Reads the full command line of a process by PID.

methods.name: parseListeners
methods.description: Parses lsof output text into a list of listener structs.

methods.name: buildReport
methods.description: Constructs a port report based on listeners and expected conditions.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Gets the executable path of a process by PID on Darwin/macOS.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process by PID using SIGTERM and SIGKILL.

methods.name: isExpected
methods.description: Determines if a listener process matches expected commands given the mode.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Probes the health of the gateway if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: loadRecords
methods.description: Loads recorded port usage data from a file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists current port records to a file.
